title: Argentinian-Style Fish Tempura
description: A Japanese-inspired twist on the classic Argentinian dish, featuring crispy fish tempura with a side of tangy dipping sauce.
instructions: Cut the fish into bite-sized pieces and season with salt and pepper.
Heat about 1/2 inch (1 cm) of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
Once the oil is hot, carefully place the fish pieces into the oil and fry until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fish from the oil with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
In a small bowl, mix together the festive and yeasty ingredients to make a dipping sauce.
Serve the tempura fish with a side of the dipping sauce for a delicious and crispy treat.
Serve with a side of steamed vegetables or rice for a well-rounded meal.
